description.en: OpenAI API provider with GPT models, Codex image-model chat compatibility, billing windows, and banked rate-limit reset credits. Responses turns are shaped as Codex CLI sends them — sampling knobs and stored-item references shed, the conversation named so its prompt cache is reused — and the model catalog follows the backend's own visibility and priority. Image generation and edits run as a Responses turn with the image_generation tool, because the Codex images routes answer OAuth with an edge 403, and the picture comes back as data[].b64_json.
description.zh: OpenAI API 提供商，支持 GPT 模型、Codex 图像模型 Chat 兼容、额度窗口，以及限额重置券查询与使用。Responses 请求按 Codex CLI 的方式整形——去掉采样参数与已存条目引用、按会话命名以复用提示缓存；模型目录遵循后端自身的可见性与优先级。图像生成与编辑走带 image_generation 工具的 Responses 回合，因为 Codex 的 images 路由对 OAuth 返回边缘 403；图片以 data[].b64_json 返回。

help_text.en: Use the Codex upstream WebSocket for Responses WebSocket sessions.
help_text.zh: 让 Responses WebSocket 会话使用 Codex 上游 WebSocket。
